nodes.label: Candidate Package
nodes.rationale: Packages carry source identity, build artifacts, task configuration and debug symbols; identical project versions must produce byte-identical ZIPs so staged builds can be verified and reused, while tampered or differently-manifested sources are rejected.

nodes.label: Continuous Path Virtual Backend
nodes.rationale: Continuous execution is wired only to the standalone Linux virtual backend; motion candidate activation is refused when no matching backend is configured, because real EcMotion Continuous adaptation is not implemented.

nodes.label: 15 Self-Developed Control Algorithms
nodes.rationale: Library includes positional, incremental and cascade PID variants plus custom algorithm blocks, supplied as ST function blocks draggable from the resource palette.

nodes.label: Download and Application Workflow
nodes.rationale: Compile, download, activate and run are distinct states by design; indeterminate communication results require a manual refresh rather than automatic retry, and the prior run/stop state is restored and verified after applying.

nodes.label: Hardware and Network Configuration
nodes.rationale: Deliberately offline project configuration: pages stay synchronized and persist with the project, but nothing is downloaded to the bus or written to device networking yet.

nodes.label: ST Online Monitoring
nodes.rationale: Values are sampled every 500 ms from authoritative debug mappings only; display markers never enter source, saved files or compilation, and dynamic array indices are deliberately not guessed.

nodes.label: .stproj Project Format
nodes.rationale: Source files are stored as immutable versions so edits made during a save are never overwritten.

nodes.label: STruC++ 0.7.0 Compiler Adapter
nodes.rationale: The GPL compiler is kept as a separate process behind an adapter and pinned to version 0.7.0 so the proprietary workstation avoids linking GPL code.

nodes.label: ST Workbench
nodes.rationale: Self-developed ST engineering workstation with an Avalonia desktop UI, targeting a standalone OpenPLC Runtime v4.3.0; only ST is implemented, ladder logic is intentionally deferred.

nodes.label: Commercial Licensing Boundary
nodes.rationale: Commercial distribution is a hard project constraint, so the boundary between the proprietary workstation and the independent GPL compile tool, third-party runtime exceptions and release TODOs are tracked; no licensing approval has been concluded for the final closed-source package.

nodes.label: Verification and Boundary Rules
nodes.rationale: Device verification must be recorded separately and cannot be substituted by local simulated tests; physical axis motion, real EtherCAT IO download and true EtherCAT scanning remain unverified.

nodes.label: Axis Control Lease (scan-renewed)
nodes.community_name: 基础轴控接口 (Basic Axis Control)
nodes.rationale: 控制租约只在实际 PLC 扫描提交有效命令后获取、且只有递增的成功扫描续租，使失去扫描的客户端无法继续持有轴的执行权。

nodes.label: Axis Fault Isolation from Engineering Channel
nodes.community_name: 基础轴控接口 (Basic Axis Control)
nodes.norm_label: axis fault isolation from engineering channel
nodes.rationale: 轴故障不再把正常的工程通信、在线采样、编译、传输或激活身份核验判为核心离线，因此一次驱动器故障不会切断工程管理通道。

nodes.label: Capability-File Heartbeat (1 s instead of 10 ms)
nodes.community_name: 基础轴控接口 (Basic Axis Control)
nodes.norm_label: capability-file heartbeat (1 s instead of 10 ms)
nodes.rationale: 原服务每 10 ms 原子重写能力文件并 fsync，磁盘同步阻塞其唯一协议处理线程导致读帧超过 200 ms；改为状态变化立即发布、不变时每秒更新一次，仍满足部署端 5 秒新鲜度检查，且易失性心跳不再 fsync。
